title: Office Pantry & Beverage Program Tariff Schedule: Programme Fee and Per-Head Charge
content:
Recurring charges for the Office Pantry & Beverage Program are printed against the tier held, in United States dollars, together with the invoice day, the contractual annual escalation and the notice period for product price rises.

| Tier | Standard monthly programme fee (USD) | Monthly charge for each badged employee served (USD) | Day of the month the programme invoice is raised | Contractual annual escalation on the programme fee (percent) | Notice before product prices rise (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 185.00 | 4.25 | 3 | 3.50 | 45 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 465.00 | 7.80 | 6 | 3.75 | 60 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 1180.00 | 11.40 | 10 | 3.90 | 60 |
| Barista Bar Program | 2450.00 | 14.20 | 14 | 4.00 | 90 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 4180.00 | 17.60 | 18 | 4.15 | 90 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 8950.00 | 9.85 | 22 | 3.80 | 120 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The monthly programme fee is the standard monthly fee for the pantry tier. The per-head figure is the monthly charge for each badged employee served, and is a rate for one employee for one month rather than a figure for the site.
- The invoice day is a day of the month, taking a value from 1 to 28 inclusive, on which the programme invoice for that tier is raised.
- The escalation figure is the contractual annual escalation that applies to the programme fee, expressed as a percentage.
- The notice figure is the number of calendar days of notice given before product prices rise.

## Points of judgement on the figures

Question: is the per-head figure printed against a tier a figure for the site or for one employee?
Answer: it is the monthly charge for each badged employee served. On Standard Snack Pantry that figure is 7.80 for one badged employee for one month, and it is not a monthly figure for the site as a whole.

Question: two tiers show the same notice period.
Answer: Fresh Pantry Program and Standard Snack Pantry each carry 60 calendar days of notice before product prices rise, while Barista Bar Program and Full Hospitality Pantry Program each carry 90. The figures are printed tier by tier and neighbouring tiers may coincide.
